## Validation
Commands and actual results, including skipped or unavailable checks:

## Review and handoff
- [ ] Exact commit reviewed; actionable findings resolved or explicitly accepted
- [ ] Existing files, media and user settings preserved
- [ ] No credentials, personal configuration or client data exposed
- [ ] Runtime claims are supported by runtime evidence
- [ ] Handoff records blockers and next action
- [ ] Owner approval obtained before merge/release/install where required

## Risks and rollback
Revert the scoped commit through review; do not reset unrelated work.
